description: Enterprise techniques used by MiniJunk, ATT&CK software S9053 (v1.0)
name: MiniJunk (S9053)

techniques.comment: [MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has leveraged HTTPS calls to the C2.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)

[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has been executed using the auto-run registry key `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\MigAutoPlay` that executes the benign windows executable `MigAutoPlay`.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has the ability to move or rename files.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has listed all hard drives or has listed files within a specified directory.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has a command that is capable of deleting a file.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has the ability to load a DLL from the C2.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has utilized Windows API calls to make HTTPs requests to C2.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)

[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has obfuscated code that utilized junk code insertion, control-flow obfuscation, opaque predicates, obfuscated function calls, and encrypted strings to hinder analysis.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)

[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has encoded network data by converting strings into bytes, then reversing the bytes and the entire strings. [MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has also encrypted strings to obfuscate code.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has been delivered within a malicious zip file.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has been compiled through several obfuscation techniques to include junk code insertion.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has the ability to validate running processes.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has leveraged legitimate digital signatures from SSL[.]com to appear legitimate.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has the ability to gather the computer name.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
[MiniJunk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9053) has collected the domain name with username.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
